notes: Copy to npc-policy.json and fill in blockedBaseDescs. While the list is empty the service removes NOTHING, even with enabled=true. See docs/technical/NPC_POLICY_DECISION.md.
_about_blockedBaseDescs: A BLOCK list, not an allow list. Only what is listed here gets removed. The previous version of this service did the opposite (an empty allowlist removed the whole world).
_about_the_format: Use the 'idHex:plugin.esm' desc, never the numeric FormID. The first byte of a FormID is the load order index, so the same number points to different records on clients with a different load order (MODS_AND_GAMEMODE_CONTRACT.md section 3). The desc carries the plugin in the value itself and survives reordering.

_example_entry.why: example — replace with real records after the curation in section 4 of NPC_POLICY_DECISION

_about_safeRadius: An NPC at this distance or closer to a connected player is not touched, so nobody sees an actor vanish in front of them. Infinity is not accepted; use a number.
_about_mode: 'disable' turns the actor off (reversible with enable). 'delete' does NOT exist on purpose: deleting a persistent reference cannot be undone, and the MVP decision is Selective Spawn, not scorched earth.
